description:
Retro-Amiga brings the Commodore Amiga to your tablet, built on Amiberry, the emulator behind most of the Amiga handhelds and single-board machines people actually play on.

AROS ROM INCLUDED
The app carries the AROS ROM, an open reimplementation of AmigaOS, so you have something to start from without hunting for files. Add a real Kickstart later for full compatibility.

LOAD WHAT YOU ALREADY HAVE
Floppy images (ADF, ADZ, IPF, DMS, SCP, FDI), hard drives (HDF, HDZ, VHD), CD images (ISO, CUE, CHD) and WHDLoad archives (LHA, LZX). Drop files in through the Files app or open them in from anywhere on your device. Zipped downloads work as they are, with no unpacking.

WHDLOAD, SET UP FOR YOU
Install WHDLoad once and the app handles the rest, so a downloaded LHA starts the way it was meant to rather than dropping you at a Workbench prompt.

A LIBRARY THAT ORGANISES ITSELF
Everything you import is catalogued automatically, with artwork and a history of what you have been playing.

PICK YOUR AMIGA
A500, A1200, CD32 and more, chosen from a guided setup rather than a wall of options. Configurations are saved, so switching machines takes one tap.

SAVE STATES
The emulator writes a state on the way out, so Resume picks up exactly where you stopped.

CONTROLS YOU CAN MOVE
On-screen joystick, CD32 pad and Amiga keyboard, laid out for touch. The pad designer lets you drag every button where your thumbs actually are, and MFi and Bluetooth controllers are supported throughout.

MOD MUSIC
Import tracker modules (MOD, MED, XM, S3M, IT) and they play in the launcher's own replayer, so the music is there while you browse. Twenty of the Amiga's best-known tunes are listed as suggestions to go and find; none are included.

ABOUT KICKSTART ROMS
Commodore's Kickstart ROMs are still under copyright and cannot be shipped with an emulator, so this app falls back to AROS, which is free to distribute. AROS is a reimplementation rather than a clone: it runs the Workbench and a good deal of software, but most WHDLoad titles and some floppies want the real thing. If you want those, supply your own Kickstart -- Cloanto sell them as Amiga Forever, and if you own an Amiga you may already have one. The app scans for what you provide and files it in the right place.
promotionalText: A real Amiga in your hands: floppies, hard drives, WHDLoad and CD32, with save states, a library that organises itself, and controls you can move.
